Hi Luis - Rishi from Redwood infra here. Quick technical answers to your Qs below (happy to expand on the security call):

SOC 2:
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Q3 2024 (reporting period: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31). We can share the redacted report under NDA / controlled access.

EU region & data residency:
- We operate production regions in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 (managed hosted). For hosted customers you can pin storage and inference to an EU region.
- Data-at-rest is encrypted (AES-256) and we support CMEK via customer KMS where requested (customer-managed keys).
- By default, application data (tokens, model inputs/outputs) stays in-region for processing; metadata/control-plane operations are logically separated. For customers with strict residency needs we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments where both control plane and data plane reside within the customer VPC/region.

Cross-border backups & control plane:
- Hosted backups are replicated within the EU when the account is configured for EU residency. For some managed features (metric aggregation, telemetry) summary telemetry is sent to our control plane; we offer options to disable telemetry and provide a private control plane for Private deployments. We can include contract language and SCCs where required.

Export controls / OFAC / ITAR:
- We perform OFAC/SDN screening on billing and contractual counterparts as part of procurement; we also provide contractual representations around sanctions compliance.
- ITAR: we do not run ITAR-restricted workloads on our public hosted endpoints by default. For ITAR or similarly restricted data, the recommended path is Private on-prem or a fully isolated Dedicated deployment with agreed operational controls.

I'll attach a short data-flow diagram and a checklist for what we'll need to complete the questionnaire.

- Rishi
